title: cad_check_override
description: CP-62 (Truong 2026-11-07): recorded Admin override of CP-60 cross-check 4 for kinematic-only planning (jobs/<job>/cad_check_override.json). cad_check.json keeps status red; the override applies only to the cad_check.json whose SHA-256 it records (a new or changed check voids it). Allows seam saving and Plan with collision off; Plan with collision on and every release scope still refuse while check 4 is red. Checks 1, 5, 6 and a stale check are never overridden.

by.description: user name of the Admin who recorded the override

reason.description: free text, e.g. 'OI-23: jig bearing seats / belts not separated in the cell CAD'

scope.description: collision off only (CP-58); never collision-on planning or release

findings.description: check-4 findings copied from cad_check.json at the time of the override (component names of the static objects hit)
